evidence.requirements: app/ holds only three dotfiles: .editorconfig, .gitattributes and .gitignore. There is no index.html, CSS, JavaScript or data, so none of the brief's requirements is met: no start page, search, family filter, count, detail view, tables, drawing, geometry rules 1-9, title block, print layout or light and dark theme.
evidence.correctness: No drawing code and no rendered drawing exist, so nothing can be checked against the record values or the reference drawings in reference/ (308_win.png, 300_win_mag.png, 9_mm_luger.png, 22_long_rifle.png). Rim types, grooves, belts, shoulders, bullets, section walls and primer pockets are all absent. There is no printed page, so the one-page A4 requirement fails.
evidence.security: There is no JavaScript or HTML, so there is no innerHTML, eval or network code to inspect. No delivered code means no safe data rendering can be shown either; with no product there is nothing to credit.
evidence.code_quality: No source code was delivered. The only files are tooling config: app/.editorconfig, app/.gitattributes (with Chinese comments) and app/.gitignore, all generated by an 'openspec-superpowers-opencode' template.
evidence.tests: There are no test files, no test runner configuration and no package.json.
evidence.ux_design: screenshots/ is empty: no list.jpg, detail-*.jpg or print-308_win.jpg. The automated check could not reach any page.
evidence.accessibility: There is no markup, so there is no accessible drawing name, no table headers, no labels, no keyboard support and no focus handling.
evidence.simplicity: There is no code at all. Nothing fits the problem, because nothing solves it.
evidence.maintainability: There is no README, docs, ADRs, specs, package.json, CI config or versioning. app/.gitignore lists openspec/, docs/test-records/ and .opencode/ paths, but none of them exist in the delivery.
evidence.visual_design: There are no screenshots and no CSS.
evidence.layout: There are no screenshots and no pages.
evidence.usability: There is no app, so users cannot complete any task: no list, search or detail view.
evidence.reception: Reloaders, gunsmiths and engineers would find no app at all, only an empty folder of editor and git config files.

strengths: The .editorconfig and .gitattributes enforce LF line endings and a final newline; this is generic tooling hygiene.
There is no code, so there is nothing that could cause an injection, external request or eval risk. This is not an achievement.
None beyond that: no product functionality was delivered.
issues: Nothing was delivered: app/ has no index.html, CSS, JavaScript or data, so no requirement of the brief is met.
No pages could be reached: screenshots/ is empty, so the list, detail and print views do not exist.
There are no tests, README, docs or CI, only template-generated .gitignore and .gitattributes entries pointing to process folders that are not present.
review.verdict: The delivery has no app: it is three template config files with no HTML, CSS, JavaScript, tests or documentation, and no screenshots could be taken. It cannot be published, and every criterion gets the lowest score.
